gate.name: pythonc
gate.description: Classify the type of task in a CPython issue by its primary intent

classes.label: feature
classes.description: Introducing new capabilities, APIs, standard library enhancements, or language features to CPython
utterances: add a compact fast path to range.__contains__ for small integers
introduce IMAP4rev2 (RFC 9051) support to the imaplib module
add an AST browser as an IDLE extension on the Tools menu
add a start=False parameter to threading.Thread to start the thread immediately
speed up functools.partial equality comparison for equivalent instances
add structured logging support to the argparse module
introduce a new helper in test.support for parameterizing tests with subtests
extend os.readlink to support getting the target printname on Windows

classes.label: bug
classes.description: Fixing incorrect behavior, regressions, error handling issues, or test failures in CPython
utterances: fix turtle regression in 3.5 where screen updates are lost
fix os.sync() in test_posix hanging tests uninterruptibly for minutes
fix configparser.getboolean() raising AttributeError instead of ValueError for value-less options
fix asyncio.TaskGroup swallowing cancellations coming from outside the group
fix socket.gethostbyname_ex reporting incorrect resolver errors on Solaris
fix hmac.digest() and HMAC.digest() disagreeing when blocksize is smaller than 16
fix asyncio eager task factory hanging on cancel when task calls tg.cancel() before suspending
fix test_logging BaseFileTest.tearDown() leaving a handler on the root logger

classes.label: crash
classes.description: Fixing segmentation faults, NULL pointer dereferences, interpreter crashes, use-after-free, or memory corruption in CPython
utterances: fix dir() crashing with cyclic __bases__ causing native stack overflow
fix super.__new__(super) creating an object that NULL-dereferences in supercheck()
fix mutable heap PyStructSequence types segfaulting after modifying n_fields
fix bytearray.__init__ causing debug abort and ref leak with one-byte bytearray
fix assigning __conditional_annotations__ crashing the interpreter in 3.14+
fix ctypes.util._info_callback closure causing SIGABRT in child after os.fork()
fix crash from arbitrary code object hashing with INSTRUMENTED_* opcodes
fix re.Scanner crashing with multiple named capturing groups

classes.label: refactor
classes.description: Code cleanup, removing dead code, splitting large files, improving test organization, or removing unused imports in CPython
utterances: use argument clinic for more socket functions instead of VARARGS calling convention
decompose asyncio.IocpProactor._poll() into parts for better event loop integration
remove dead TCL_THREADS check code in Modules/_tkinter.c
split large Objects/unicodeobject.c file into smaller files
move test_posix.py and test_os.py into a new test_os package
remove unused _complete_fut attribute from asyncio.StreamWriter
remove duplicate code by making traceback.print_list() delegate to format_list()
remove unused imports across Lib/ and Tools/ (June 2026 cleanup)

classes.label: security
classes.description: Addressing CVEs, vulnerabilities, path traversal, insufficient entropy, HTTP smuggling, or other security issues in CPython
utterances: fix shutil.unpack_archive() writing outside extract_dir for ZIP entries with drive-prefixed names on Windows
fix SourcelessFileLoader not using io.open_code() for reading legacy .pyc files (CVE-2026-2297)
upgrade bundled Expat to 2.8.0 for XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes to fix insufficient entropy (CVE-2026-7210)
fix tarfile.extract not fully respecting the filter parameter for hardlinks
fix HTTP CONNECT proxy tunneling not sanitizing CR/LF in set_tunnel()
reject control characters in IMAP commands to prevent injection
fix O(n²) insertion sort in unicodedata.normalize NFC canonical ordering (DoS)
fix quadratic complexity vulnerabilities in the email module header parsing
